trial: Direct Continuous Contour/Morphology Trial2 fresh caption validation
question: Does the immutable direct morphology representation generalize to newly source-confirmed ordinary horizontal writing in caption groups unused for its similarity result?
freshness: New to prior V3 detailed parent/morphology fitting/selection, V5/V6 detailed source corpora, feature-trial inputs/specification, direct Trial1 corpus and known prior source-similarity pair sets. V4 broad parent extraction/application and older native overview exposure remain, so not globally unseen photography. Audit uses source identifiers only; no class labels or prohibited metadata values inspected.
selection: Frozen eight captions/two horizontal fields each after nativeRGB layout review. Sample up to24 primary area>=35/core>=8 parent proposals per caption with fixed seed, spread by field; keep all membership/source uncertainty. No replacement because of morphology, recurrence or test performance. Sampling does not certify full writing-ink recall.
source_adjudication: NativeRGB whole field/individual candidates before any new contour/SDF distances, V3 labels or conventional metadata. Confirm writing/nonwriting/unresolved, whole extent resolved/unknown, possible joins/splits, neighboring contamination and field-edge state. No source judgment inferred from nearest morphology. Freeze source judgments before building candidates/distances.
immutable_representation: Import frozen Trial1 normalize/sdf/slant and contour_matrix/sdf_matrix/envelopes unchanged. Same native9/6/12 candidates including>=5% overlaps, fragments/unions/merges and±.04 slant;64px/56support aspect/orientation preserving nearest resampling. Primary contour64 normalized symmetricChamfer; SDF64secondary;32/128contour sensitivity only. No rotation/reflection, learning, PCA, prototypes, V3 labels or required named-feature profile. Unknown physical extent remains unknown; candidate envelopes not physical posteriors.

pair_sampling.population: Fresh-vs-fresh source-confirmed, whole-extent-resolved parents in different selected captions. Old source parents used only for separate retrieval.
pair_sampling.mixture: Half broad random cross-caption pairs, half aspect-matched(abs native log width/height difference<=.35) geometric comparisons. Balance caption dyads by cycling all available combinations, cycle anchor native-envelope-area quartiles for size coverage. Seeded tie/pair choice; no contour or source similarity judgment used.
pair_sampling.extension_rule: Prepare deterministic ordered600-pair pool and hidden-key/source galleries before first rating. Open initial240. Add next120only if binary n<120, same<30,different<30, endpoint-caption coverage<6 or either rating category spans<4 captions. Stop when support achieved or600 exhausted. All opened pairs included; no metric inspected before final ratings seal. If sampling constraints cannot fill600, retain available pool and not-estimable support if minimum unachieved.
pair_sampling.fallbacks: If requested aspect-matched dyad/area stratum has no unused pair, cycle next dyad; if no remaining aspect candidates, leave shortfall explicit, do not replace with nearest-contour pairs. Never change parent eligibility after ratings.
pair_sampling.blind_display: Anonymous sourceRGB crops with source-coordinate bbox as locational aid, equal-size slots, randomized left/right. No caption/parent IDs, selector/aspect values, contour/SDF scores, V3 labels or conventional strings shown.
pair_sampling.ratings: 2 same whole visual organization allowing source-supported ink/size/slant differences;1 partial/related organization;0 different;U unresolved. Preserve1/U, excluded from binary only. Same AI adjudicator, not human inter-rater.
pair_sampling.freeze: Pair pool/protocol sealed before source-similarity rating. All used ratings sealed before predictions. No outcome-informed choosing of metric or normalization.

repeat.selection: Seed+1 uniform subset of all opened source pairs, including partial/U. Anonymous changed IDs/left-right before hidden-key comparison.
repeat.separation: Intervening candidate-generation/representation verification, no prior IDs/ratings displayed; same-session conversational memory persists. Same-adjudicator repeatability only.

statistics.primary: Contour64 AUROC rating2vs0 on all resolved binary opened pairs; ordinal association on0/1/2 secondary. Compare same-pair native log-aspect-only baseline.
statistics.bootstrap: 2000 two-endpoint caption/node bootstrap draws8 caption counts with replacement; pair weight=count(caption_left)*count(caption_right). Paired same weights for contour-aspect deltas. Report only with>=1800 valid two-category resamples; otherwise inferential support not estimable. Parent reuse within captions and same-AI dependence remain limitations.
statistics.secondary: SDF64 AUROC, contour32/128 sensitivities and leave-one-caption-out descriptives; no winner substitution.

uncertainty: Record primary/minimum/maximum observed candidate distances separately from source extent qualification. No posterior/physical interval. Separate fresh-query vs frozen Trial1 reference88(parents whose corpus is reference), disjoint captions. Report nearest identity, guaranteed-nearest across all candidate alternatives, not-excluded set,32/64/128neighbor stability and changed-neighbor cases. Low guaranteed-nearest fraction is diagnostic, not an automatic failure gate.
not_estimable: Any sample/category/caption/bootstrap support shortage produces not-estimable support, with point results retained if mathematically computable; never substitute reused pairs or a sensitivity resolution. Adequate sample but failed metric gates is not-supported or partially-supported as frozen criteria warrant.
prohibited: V3 classes before final Trial2 freeze
metric/raster hypothesis chosen for match quality
final_freeze: Immutable Trial2 package includes selection audit/seal, source judgments/seal, ensemble inputs, pair protocol/pool, anonymous ratings/seals, repeat, metrics, uncertainty, failures, replay and integrity. Only after final freeze interpret as supported/partially supported/not supported/not estimable. Success concerns source-traceable visible morphology only, not writing-system/semantic/transcription units.
